title: Soda can in the vapour chamber

tokens.v: Stand it low in the frame with fog pooling to its base and the column of light rising empty above it for two thirds of the height. 50mm at f/4, camera a little below the lid line. Let the falloff die to near-black within a hand's width of the body so the matte coat drinks the beam while the bare lid rim and the pull-tab rivet take the only hard speculars. Condensation stands proud across the shoulder. A vapour curl crosses the bottom edge out of focus, cut by the right edge; at this distance the wrap print reads as one green band.
